reason: Same rate-odds conflict as the Round 2 check applies here, and it matters more for this book because it is explicitly a Fed-outcome bet: investing.com's Fed Rate Monitor (CME fed funds futures) shows 90.1% for a hold at 3.75-4.00% and 9.9% for a 25bp cut, zero probability on a hike, while a Bing News sweep of recent headlines describes hike odds 'surged to over 80%' (CME FedWatch cited above 60% in one source) tied to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, a rebounding August payrolls print, and firmer inflation/oil -- the two sources are not reconcilable from here, which is exactly the split the desk was warned about. Given that, I'm not adding size or flipping direction blind the day before the print. The book's own 2026-09-08 reassessment already leaned into the hawkish/hike scenario -- short GDX (gold miners, +4.25% on this leg: a hike/firmer-real-yields tape is a headwind for gold) and short BTC (+notional, risk-off crypto is the standard reaction to a hawkish surprise) -- so if the Bing News narrative is the one that's live, this book is already correctly positioned for it, with stops (-12% to -15%) doing the work of capping the tail if the investing.com hold-odds reading turns out to be the accurate one instead. The only long, XBI, is an idiosyncratic biotech M&A thesis that I didn't find any news moving today, so it stays as a diversifier uncorrelated to the rate call. Gross exposure is already modest (39%) with 61% in cash earning 4% APY, which is the right amount of dry powder to redeploy once the FOMC outcome actually confirms which side was right, rather than paying full book-replacement friction to guess it now. Holding through the print.
